changes.title: Hotbar settings removed
changes.text: Removed the withdrawn hotbar layout and food-placement settings; Cleric spell-button settings remain directly accessible.

changes.title: Cleric settings preserved
changes.text: Android checks now verify the hotbar settings are absent and the four Cleric spell-button choices still respond to taps.

changes.title: Development evidence
changes.text: Updated the development report and verification request for the removed hotbar settings and historical reconstruction.

changes.title: Historical private-test navigation
changes.text: Corrected obsolete private-test references that could prevent Change History from opening after reconstruction.

changes.title: Missing-record regressions
changes.text: Added permanent checks that recovered private-test entries supersede obsolete aliases and missing historical files block preparation.

changes.title: Produced APK attribution
changes.text: History preservation can recover an APK produced before a later Android failure without labeling that earlier APK playable or verified.

changes.title: Exact recent build records
changes.text: Preserved TEST68's produced APK changes and identified TEST69's stopped preparation without assigning changes to a nonexistent APK.

changes.title: Failure and verification records
changes.text: Recorded the failed Android history check, blocked preparation, fix and new verification request.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I removed the withdrawn hotbar settings while keeping Cleric controls available. I also corrected old private-test history references caught by the Android checks.
